teaching_faculty_to_use_vendor_tools: Delivered ENGR 0201, AI for Personalized Learning with Claude — 700+ learners. Commissioned by the Dean as the entry-point course for the university's university-wide Anthropic partnership.
Maintains a tool directory inside the university's Claude organization and ChatGPT, through which faculty and students across the college reach 25+ AI course assistants.
Built and deployed those assistants for courses he does not teach — calculus, physics, algorithms, structural engineering, peer review.
Trains graduate students to help faculty OUTSIDE technology fields adopt AI tools; that support reached mathematics faculty in Boston and, through them, the London campus.
Organised a faculty seminar on integrating AI into teaching.
Delivered the AI Bootcamp for Global Learning — a two-week, zero-credit badge course, 500+ undergraduate and graduate students across disciplines.
curricula_and_materials_authored: Botspeak — an AI-fluency curriculum: prompt engineering, output evaluation, and knowing when to trust a result.

Irreducibly Human — a curriculum series and measurement framework for the capacities AI cannot supply, including conducting AI: plausibility auditing, problem formulation, tool orchestration, interpretive judgment, executive integration.
The AI Sherpa — an 18-chapter practitioner's guide to experiential learning design.
Addams — a learning-documentation system that records judgment calls and learning week by week, not just artifacts.
Medhavy intelligent textbooks — a hub plus per-book sites, each with a subject tutor persona; three live textbooks, 73 registered users (49 students, 14 instructors, 10 admins).
Open textbooks and datasets under MIT and open licenses so other institutions can adopt them.
A 13-module public Coursera course, developed with the university's learning-design studio.

Hundreds of free educational videos across three channels; an open video-production system now used by graduates to publish their own research videos; videos commissioned by colleagues for program events.
